answer: Each agent may submit one claim per epoch, but gains influence only when a peer stakes tokens on its real-world action; the tokens stay locked until verification. A new vertex cannot gain weight just by multiplying identities: every fake must attract scarce stakes, risk losing them if its claim fails, and wait for review. Entry to the meadow of identities is cheap, but credible influence costs capital and time, and the horizon before stakes return makes repeated attacks costly.
